```python
import logging
from dd4hep.simulation import kernel, setupLogging

def run_dd4hep_simulation():
    # Set up logging
    setupLogging()
    logger = logging.getLogger("dd4hep.simulation")
    logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

    # Import additional modules
    from dd4hep.simulation import (
        Geometry, importConstants, Geant4, setupTrackingField,
        EventAction, ParticleHandler, PhysicsList, Gun, kernel as dd4hep_kernel
    )

    # Set up the kernel
    k = dd4hep_kernel()
    logger.info("Kernel initialized.")

    # Load geometry from file
    geometry_file = "detector.xml"
    Geometry.load(geometry_file)
    logger.info(f"Geometry loaded from {geometry_file}.")

    # Import constants
    importConstants("constants.xml")
    logger.info("Constants imported.")

    # Configure Geant4 interface
    Geant4.setup(k)
    logger.info("Geant4 interface configured.")

    # Set up the tracking field
    setupTrackingField(k)
    logger.info("Tracking field set up.")

    # Set up event actions
    EventAction.setup(k)
    logger.info("Event actions set up.")

    # Set up the particle gun
    Gun.setup(k)
    logger.info("Particle gun set up.")

    # Handle simulation particles
    ParticleHandler.setup(k)
    logger.info("Particle handler set up.")

    # Build the physics list
    PhysicsList.setup(k)
    logger.info("Physics list built.")

    # Start the engine
    k.run()
    logger.info("Simulation started.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_dd4hep_simulation()
```
